description: This file defines the RelatedEntitiesParser class, which processes a source file to extract entity IDs and their types based on specific table patterns, primarily used for data migration in the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: RelatedEntitiesParser
classes.description: A parser class that reads a source file to map entity UUIDs to their types based on table patterns.

methods.name: RelatedEntitiesParser
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser with a source file and processes all tables.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type associated with a given UUID.

methods.name: isBlockFinished
methods.description: Checks if a line indicates the end of a data block.

methods.name: processAllTables
methods.description: Iterates through the file lines to identify and process relevant data blocks based on table patterns.

methods.name: processBlock
methods.description: Processes a block of lines corresponding to a specific entity type, extracting IDs.
